basic_info.description: 3 spacious remodeled flats delivered vacant in Prime Nob Hill neighborhood. Great for owner user, multifamily and/or investors. Projected gross annual rental income over $225,000. Classic Edwardian  style with period details: hardwood floors, high ceilings, bay windows, beautiful decorative interior trims/moldings throughout, wainscot paneling, pocket and French doors which ties in this charming era.  Each unit has a formal living room, and a formal dining room, and laundry room. Unit  Building has fire sprinkler protection. Full basement with multi storage rooms, two multipurpose rooms with refinished hardwood floors with common area toilet. Good size backyard with new fencing and lighting. Centrally located in highly desirable area, walking distances to Trader Joe's, Whole food, Grace Cathedral and Polk Street Corridor; or hop on the Cable Car and enjoy the ride taking in the sights of our beautiful city.  Parking available and current owner uses State Garage a block away and loves the valet service.
